labels.EMPIRICAL: historical replay of real data; bounded fills
labels.CALIBRATED: a point-calibrated generator fitted on development and selected on selection
labels.POSTERIOR_SAMPLE: a draw from a registered posterior
labels.STRUCTURAL_INTERVENTION: a calibrated world with one registered mechanism changed
labels.SYNTHETIC_STRESS: a deliberately implausible or extreme scenario; never in the plausible set

rules: Every simulated world carries exactly one label in its manifest.
Only CALIBRATED and POSTERIOR_SAMPLE worlds enter the plausible world set.
SYNTHETIC_STRESS results are reported separately and never support robustness claims.
